site_settings.value: ORIVANA Health is a healthcare access and coordination initiative within the ORIVANA Global Foundation ecosystem. It is not a hospital and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.
Healthcare access, medical assistance coordination, medical tourism, medical training and healthcare partnerships.

pages.title: Medical disclaimer
pages.body:
ORIVANA Health is a healthcare access and coordination initiative. It is not a hospital, clinic or diagnostic service, and nothing on this website is medical advice, a diagnosis or a recommendation for treatment. Medical decisions must be made with qualified and licensed healthcare professionals.

In an emergency, contact your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department immediately. Do not use this website for emergencies.

ORIVANA Health does not promise treatment, financial assistance, visas, admission, travel arrangements or any medical outcome.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.body:
ORIVANA Health collects only the information needed to respond to your request, coordinate your case or provide your account. Medical records you upload are stored in a private store, are visible only to authorised ORIVANA staff who need them, and are never published. A case is shown publicly only if it has been verified, you have given separate consent for public sharing, and an administrator has approved the specific wording.

We use your contact details to reply to you and, if you consented, to send updates about your case. We do not sell personal data. You may ask us to correct or delete your information by writing to us through the contact page; some records may need to be kept where the law requires.

Payment card details are never stored by ORIVANA. Where online payments are enabled they are handled by a regulated payment provider.

This policy should be reviewed by ORIVANA's legal adviser and the contact and organisation details completed in Admin → Settings.

pages.title: Terms of use
pages.body:
By using this website you agree to use it lawfully and to give information that is true and complete to the best of your knowledge. ORIVANA Health coordinates information and connections; it does not provide medical services and does not guarantee any outcome, assistance, treatment, admission, visa or travel arrangement.

Content on this site is for general information only. Listings of partners, providers and equipment reflect information supplied to and verified by ORIVANA at the time of listing, and the verification status shown is the status recorded by ORIVANA.

faqs.question: Is ORIVANA Health a hospital?
faqs.answer: No. ORIVANA Health helps people navigate healthcare, connect with participating providers, and explore pathways of support. It does not diagnose or treat.

faqs.question: Does applying for medical assistance guarantee help?
faqs.answer: No. We help organise your information and explore possible pathways. We cannot promise treatment, funding or any outcome.

faqs.question: Will my case be made public?
faqs.answer: Never automatically. A case can appear publicly only if it is verified, you give separate consent for public sharing, and an administrator approves the exact wording. Medical records are never published.

faqs.question: Can I track my application?
faqs.answer: Yes. After you apply you receive a case ID and a private access code. Use them on the case tracking page to see status, messages and to upload documents.

faqs.question: Does ORIVANA arrange visas for international patients?
faqs.answer: No. We can share general documentation checklists and coordinate with participating providers, but we do not give immigration advice and cannot guarantee a visa.

faqs.question: Are online donations active?
faqs.answer: Online contributions are switched on only after a payment provider is configured and ORIVANA's legal eligibility to receive them is confirmed. The Donate for the Needy page always shows the current position.
